# The outer ring of 40 nodes. A node's edge: the farthest regular system within 15 degrees of
# its direction (none: the farthest overall); the node goes 25 beyond it. No scope.
ahw_spike_build_outer_ring_40 = {
	event_target:ahw_centre_system = {
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_1 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_2 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_3 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_4 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_5 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_6 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_7 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_8 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_9 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_10 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_11 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_12 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_13 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_14 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_15 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_16 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_17 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_18 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_19 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_20 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_21 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_22 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_23 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_24 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_25 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_26 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_27 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_28 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_29 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_30 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_31 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_32 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_33 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_34 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_35 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_36 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_37 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_38 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_39 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_40 value = 0 }
	}
	every_system = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_h value = ahw_r }
		multiply_variable = { which = ahw_h value = 0.9659 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_nx value = 0 }
		subtract_variable = { which = ahw_nx value = ahw_x }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_ny value = 0 }
		subtract_variable = { which = ahw_ny value = ahw_y }
		# only the nodes near the system's own octant (0.0.25)
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_y value >= 0 } check_variable = { which = ahw_x value >= ahw_y } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_p value = ahw_x }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_p value = 1.0 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_q value = ahw_y }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_q value = 0.0 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_p value = ahw_q }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { which = ahw_p value >= ahw_h }
					check_variable = { which = ahw_r value > event_target:ahw_centre_system.ahw_edge_1 }
				}
				event_target:ahw_centre_system = { set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_1 value = prev.ahw_r } }
			}
			set_variable = { which = ahw_p value = ahw_x }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_p value = 0.9877 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_q value = ahw_y }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_q value = 0.1564 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_p value = ahw_q }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { which = ahw_p value >= ahw_h }
					check_variable = { which = ahw_r value > event_target:ahw_centre_system.ahw_edge_2 }
				}
				event_target:ahw_centre_system = { set_variable = { which = ahw_edge_2 value = prev.ahw_r } }
			}
			set_variable = { which = ahw_p value = ahw_x }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_p value = 0.9511 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_q value = ahw_y }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_q value = 0.309 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_p value = ahw_q }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { which = ahw_p value >= ahw_h }
					check_variable = { which = ahw_r value > event_target:ahw_centre_system.ahw_edge_3 }
				}

# Pair $N$: flags first (run 4), then the gate in the portal (ahw_portal_tmp) and the exit in the
# nearest ring system (ahw_node_tmp), in the node's next free slot.
ahw_spike_make_pair = {
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		set_star_flag = ahw_entry_$N$
		set_variable = { which = ahw_pair value = $N$ }
	}
	event_target:ahw_node_tmp = {
		set_star_flag = ahw_exit_$N$
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 0 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 30 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 30 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 60 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 90 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 90 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 120 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 120 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 150 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 150 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 180 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 180 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 210 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 210 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 240 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 240 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 270 } }

		}

	event_target:ahw_node_tmp = {

# Finds the galaxy's centre: two probe systems leapfrog corewards from the innermost system; the
# better one ends as event_target:ahw_centre_system. No scope.
ahw_spike_find_centre = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.15 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.15 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.2 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.2 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.25 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.25 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.3 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.3 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.4 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.4 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.6 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.6 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	event_target:ahw_inner_tmp = {
		spawn_system = {
			min_distance = 20
			max_distance = 20
			max_jumps = 0
			direction = corewards
			initializer = ahw_spike_core_init
			hyperlane = no
			effect = { save_global_event_target_as = ahw_probe_a }
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_probe_a = {
		spawn_system = {
			min_distance = 10
			max_distance = 10
			max_jumps = 0
			direction = corewards
			initializer = ahw_spike_core_init
			hyperlane = no
			effect = { save_global_event_target_as = ahw_probe_t }
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_probe_a = { ahw_spike_measure = yes }
	event_target:ahw_probe_t = { ahw_spike_measure = yes }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 40 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 40 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 40 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 30 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 30 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 30 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 20 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 20 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 20 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 15 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 15 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 15 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 10 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 10 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 10 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 7 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 7 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 7 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 5 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 5 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 5 }
	event_target:ahw_probe_a = {
		save_global_event_target_as = ahw_centre_system
		log = "AHW SPIKE centre: best probe at distance_to_core_percent \\[This.ahw_d] (0 = the centre)"
	}
}

# Spawns the portal (-> ahw_portal_tmp) PORTAL_R from its anchor ahw_x_tmp, at the angle where its
# lane arrives farthest from the anchor's other lanes and no other system is closer than CLEAR_MIN.
# Computed from the outline's coordinates (ahw_x, ahw_y; flag ahw_xy), no moves (0.0.17).
ahw_spike_place_portal = {
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {
		# the anchor's lanes: ahw_c = 2r cos(theta), ahw_s = 2r sin(theta) of each lane's direction
		every_neighbor_system = {
			export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = distance parameters = { source = event_target:ahw_x_tmp type = euclidean } variable = ahw_l }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_c value = ahw_x }
			subtract_variable = { which = ahw_c value = prev.ahw_x }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_c value = 30 }
			divide_variable = { which = ahw_c value = ahw_l }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_s value = ahw_y }
			subtract_variable = { which = ahw_s value = prev.ahw_y }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_s value = 30 }
			divide_variable = { which = ahw_s value = ahw_l }
		}
		set_variable = { which = ahw_cl_0 value = 1000000 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_cl_30 value = 1000000 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_cl_60 value = 1000000 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_cl_90 value = 1000000 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_cl_120 value = 1000000 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_cl_150 value = 1000000 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_cl_180 value = 1000000 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_cl_210 value = 1000000 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_cl_240 value = 1000000 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_cl_270 value = 1000000 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_cl_300 value = 1000000 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_cl_330 value = 1000000 }
		# every system with coordinates near the anchor (portals and ring nodes too): at angle a its
		# squared distance from the portal is eq + cos a ec + sin a es, with u = its offset from
		# the anchor: eq = |u|^2 + r^2, ec = -2r ux, es = -2r uy
		every_system = {
			limit = {
				has_star_flag = ahw_xy
				NOT = { is_same_value = event_target:ahw_x_tmp }
				distance = { source = event_target:ahw_x_tmp max_distance <= 27 type = euclidean }
			}
			set_variable = { which = ahw_ec value = ahw_x }
			subtract_variable = { which = ahw_ec value = prev.ahw_x }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_es value = ahw_y }
			subtract_variable = { which = ahw_es value = prev.ahw_y }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_eq value = ahw_ec }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_eq value = ahw_ec }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_es }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_es }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_eq value = ahw_t }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_eq value = 225 }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_ec value = -30 }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_es value = -30 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_ec }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = 1.0 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_es }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = 0.0 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_eq }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_x_tmp.ahw_cl_0 } }
				event_target:ahw_x_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_cl_0 value = prev.ahw_t } }
			}
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_ec }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = 0.866 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_es }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = 0.5 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_eq }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_x_tmp.ahw_cl_30 } }
				event_target:ahw_x_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_cl_30 value = prev.ahw_t } }
			}
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_ec }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = 0.5 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_es }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = 0.866 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_eq }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_x_tmp.ahw_cl_60 } }

			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = -0.5 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_es }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = 0.866 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_eq }
			if = {

		set_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 0 }

	# angle 0: the worst margin over the anchor's lanes, then the clearance
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {
		set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = 1000 }
		every_neighbor_system = {
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_c }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = -0.5 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_s }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = -0.0 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_x_tmp.ahw_m } }
				event_target:ahw_x_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = prev.ahw_t } }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { which = ahw_cl value = ahw_cl_0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_cl value < 144 } }
			subtract_variable = { which = ahw_m value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_m value > ahw_best } }

			set_variable = { which = ahw_best_cl value = ahw_cl }
		}
	}
	# angle 300: the worst margin over the anchor's lanes, then the clearance
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {
		set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = 1000 }
		every_neighbor_system = {
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_c }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = -0.25 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_s }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = 0.433 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_x_tmp.ahw_m } }
				event_target:ahw_x_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = prev.ahw_t } }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { which = ahw_cl value = ahw_cl_300 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_cl value < 144 } }
			subtract_variable = { which = ahw_m value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_m value > ahw_best } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best value = ahw_m }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 300 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best_cl value = ahw_cl }
		}
	}
	# angle 330: the worst margin over the anchor's lanes, then the clearance
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {

	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {

			set_variable = { which = ahw_py value = ahw_y }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_py value = 7.5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 60 } }

	}
}

# Names the portal event_target:ahw_portal_tmp after the reach of its exit node ahw_node_tmp and
# its number in that reach (counters ahw_portals_<reach> on ring node 1). No scope.
ahw_spike_name_portal = {
	if = {
		limit = { event_target:ahw_node_tmp = { check_variable = { which = ahw_reach value = 0 } } }
		event_target:ahw_ring_1 = { change_variable = { which = ahw_portals_0 value = 1 } }
		ahw_spike_name_portal_in_reach = { R = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { event_target:ahw_node_tmp = { check_variable = { which = ahw_reach value = 1 } } }
		event_target:ahw_ring_1 = { change_variable = { which = ahw_portals_1 value = 1 } }
		ahw_spike_name_portal_in_reach = { R = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { event_target:ahw_node_tmp = { check_variable = { which = ahw_reach value = 2 } } }
		event_target:ahw_ring_1 = { change_variable = { which = ahw_portals_2 value = 1 } }
		ahw_spike_name_portal_in_reach = { R = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { event_target:ahw_node_tmp = { check_variable = { which = ahw_reach value = 3 } } }
		event_target:ahw_ring_1 = { change_variable = { which = ahw_portals_3 value = 1 } }
		ahw_spike_name_portal_in_reach = { R = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { event_target:ahw_node_tmp = { check_variable = { which = ahw_reach value = 4 } } }
		event_target:ahw_ring_1 = { change_variable = { which = ahw_portals_4 value = 1 } }
		ahw_spike_name_portal_in_reach = { R = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { event_target:ahw_node_tmp = { check_variable = { which = ahw_reach value = 5 } } }
		event_target:ahw_ring_1 = { change_variable = { which = ahw_portals_5 value = 1 } }
		ahw_spike_name_portal_in_reach = { R = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { event_target:ahw_node_tmp = { check_variable = { which = ahw_reach value = 6 } } }
		event_target:ahw_ring_1 = { change_variable = { which = ahw_portals_6 value = 1 } }
		ahw_spike_name_portal_in_reach = { R = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
